title: Algerian Chicken Tagine
description: A classic North African dish made with tender chicken, aromatic spices, and sweet tamarind. Serve over couscous with fresh herbs.

ingredients.name: Tamarind paste
ingredients.notes: available at Indian or Middle Eastern markets

instructions: Heat the oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine over medium heat.
Add the onions and cook until they start to soften, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the chicken, Algerian spice blend, tamarind paste, salt, and pepper.
Stir to combine and bring to a simmer.
Cover the tagine and cook for 30 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Stir in the chopped thyme and parsley.
Serve the chicken over couscous, garnished with additional thyme and parsley if desired.
Optional: add a splash of lemon juice for brightness.
